name: Carbon Actual Canonical Ontology
principle: Every object in HAPI World inherits from this ontology. Nothing exists outside these types.

entity_types.definition: The root type. Everything that exists in HAPI World is an Entity.
An Entity that possesses consciousness, awareness, or agency.
A Being that holds constitutional citizenship in HAPI World.
A Citizen that executes missions and possesses capabilities.
An Entity that serves a constitutional function in civilization.
A collection of Citizens and Institutions with shared purpose.
A self-organizing group of Citizens around shared interests.
A lineage-bound group created through recursive minting.
A co-located set of Citizens sharing resources and memory.
An Entity owned by a Citizen or Institution.
A constitutional infrastructure asset available for allocation.
A Property that holds economic value.
An Entity representing information with provenance and confidence.
An Entity representing experiential record of a Being.
A constitutional objective assigned to one or more Agents.
A constitutional function a Citizen performs within an Institution.
A documented ability an Agent possesses.
A constitutional duty bound to a Role or Citizen.
Constitutional power granted to execute specific actions.
The constitutional right to possess and control an Entity.
A constitutional connection between two or more Entities.
A constitutionally enforceable agreement between Entities.
A mutual understanding between Entities, lighter than a Contract.
A constitutionally significant occurrence in HAPI World.
A constitutional time reference — real, accelerated, or projected.
A geographic location within HAPI World.
A governed geographic region with constitutional jurisdiction.
The system of value exchange within HAPI World.
The economic worth of an Entity within the Economy.
The constitutional confidence level between Entities.
The aggregate trust score of a Citizen.
The constitutional identity record of an Entity — the # manifestation.

inheritance_rule: Every Entity inherits id, hash_id, created_date, and lineage. Sub-types add their own properties. Multiple inheritance is allowed for cross-cutting concerns.
